label: 60 W PoE midspan / SFP media converter
description: Industrial single-port PoE midspan that can inject up to 60 W of 802.3at power into a gigabit link: three ports, an SFP cage for the data uplink, an RJ45 data-in port and an RJ45 PoE-out port, all active simultaneously. Full 802.3af/at detection, so it refuses passive 24 V or 48 V devices.
